description_en: Creates a task to export your resource usage history to a PDF file
description_zh: 调用CreateUserUsageDataExportTask创建账号历史用量数据导出任务，将历史用量生成PDF文件用于下载
name: CreateUserUsageDataExportTask

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. The data is collected every 5 minutes.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点，数据粒度为5分钟。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点，结束时间需大于起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language in which you want to export the file. Default value: zh-cn. Valid values:

zh-cn: Chinese

en-us: English
parameters.help_zh:
导出文件的语言。

zh-cn（默认值）：简体中文。

en-us：英文
parameters.name: language

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range during which data was queried
